| β | c₁(++++)/(−8πi x²) | c₁(++−−)/(−8πi (1−x)²) | K(+−++)/(−4πi x(1−x)) | K(++00)/(−8πi x(1−x)) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1/4 | 1 + 2 × 10⁻¹⁹ | 1 + 2 × 10⁻¹⁹ | 1 + 3 × 10⁻¹⁸ | 1 + 6 × 10⁻¹⁸ |
| 1/2 | 1 + 3 × 10⁻¹⁹ | 1 + 3 × 10⁻¹⁹ | 1 + 4 × 10⁻¹⁸ | 1 + 7 × 10⁻¹⁸ |
| 2/3 | 1 + 5 × 10⁻¹⁹ | 1 + 5 × 10⁻¹⁹ | 1 + 8 × 10⁻¹⁸ | 1 + 9 × 10⁻¹⁸ |

Entries are 1 + (upper bound on the relative deviation). Of the other helicity amplitudes with
ΔJ_z = 0 or ±2, −−00 equals ++00, +−+− and −+−+ have a constant and no logarithm. All other
amplitudes with even ΔJ_z vanish in the forward limit (constant and logarithmic coefficients below 2 × 10⁻¹⁸
of the largest), and those with odd ΔJ_z vanish like p_T up to logarithms: |M| ∝ p_Tⁿ between the two
smallest δ with n between 0.74 and 1.0.

## Precision

- β = 1/2, δ = 10⁻¹⁰: 95 instead of 80 digits changes the amplitudes by at most (relative) 2 × 10⁻³⁹ (1l), 4 × 10⁻³⁷ (2l_CF), 7 × 10⁻³⁸ (2l_CA).

## Checks of the evaluation (from logs/)

- Tensor basis: the inverse of M_ik = T_i†·T_k equals the projectors of gg_projectors-1.0.inc to 4 × 10⁻⁴⁰.
- Li₂,₂: 401 of the 401 calls converge with the arguments as given, 159 with them exchanged.
- Benchmark point, one loop: all 20 coefficients agree between routes A and B to 7 × 10⁻⁵⁷.
- Benchmark point, two loops, C_F part (A1, A3, A10, A17, A2): routes A and B agree to 3 × 10⁻⁵⁶.
- Benchmark point, two loops, C_A part (same coefficients): routes A and B agree to 2 × 10⁻⁵⁶.
- Compiled C++ code (algebraic part, quad precision) against the Python translation, nine coefficients, at 2 points: largest relative difference 3 × 10⁻¹⁹ (one loop), 10⁻¹⁶ (C_F), 4 × 10⁻¹⁶ (C_A).
- Li₂,₂ against an independent integral representation, for all arguments at 4 points (1490 in total): largest relative difference 3 × 10⁻²⁵.
- p0002.cpp against the translated p0002.py, statement by statement: 1613 statements (401 Li22, 501 Li_n, 689 algebraic, 19 log, 3 zeta), 0 differ.
